title: Studio validations panel cannot author a clearable state: it drops the '' target of a state_machine row
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · found by the contract review of PR #36559 (card #36161, comment 7087685411), first noted on #36161's body as "Adjacent, for the ui lane". Not triaged; not claimed by this seat (area:ux).

## What happens
Since PR #36127, a `state_machine` rule judges a clear of its field (`null` or `''`) as a transition to `''`, allowed only from a state that lists `''` among its targets (taught in `skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` by PR #36559). The Studio validations panel cannot write such a target: it parses the targets with `.filter(Boolean)` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectValidationsPanel.tsx:597` on main ad50d611), so an admin cannot make a state clearable from Studio, and editing a row that already lists `''` silently drops it, after which users who clear the field are refused again.

## Done when
- The panel can author an empty-string target (an explicit "may be cleared" control or equivalent), and editing a row keeps an existing `''` target.
- A pin: a rule with `paused: ['open', '']` round-trips through a row edit unchanged; one ablation.

reach: every object whose state machine an admin edits in Studio and that has (or wants) a clearable state. Read from code, not reproduced in a browser.
Business reason: an app that works when written as metadata breaks for its users after an admin touches the rule in Studio.
Reader: the ui lane (`ui/packages/app-shell`, Studio design views).
Dedupe: `filter(Boolean)` targets, `clearable state`, `ObjectValidationsPanel ''` → none open (the note lived only on #36161's body, which PR #36559 closes).
Grade suggestion: p2 (fails closed; a user-visible refusal after a Studio edit, no data loss). Triage decides.
